description: This file declares the LocalStore class, which implements the ILocalStore interface for managing local database storage using SQLite. It includes method declarations for opening the database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving counts and entries, removing entries, and adding entries. It also contains private utility methods and member variables related to database connection management.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements the ILocalStore interface for local data persistence using SQLite. Provides methods to manage database tables and entries, encapsulating the database connection details.

methods.name: LocalStore
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the LocalStore object.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a database connection at the specified file path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a sequence of entries from a table starting at a specified index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries between start and end indices in a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Private utility method to construct SQL query for fetching event data.
